# PersonalAI Architecture

## Core Documents

- [[AI Behavior]]

## High Level Architecture

```text
Obsidian
    ↓
Knowledge Base
    ↓
Vector Search
    ↓
Knowledge Engine
    ↓
Developer Agent
    ↓
Code Generation
```

---

## Components

### Obsidian

Stores all knowledge.

### Knowledge Engine

Responsible for:

- note creation
- note updates
- note linking
- note refactoring

### Developer Agent

Responsible for:

- code generation
- code analysis
- repository understanding
- architecture suggestions

The assistant should gradually improve the knowledge base by:

- creating notes
- updating notes
- linking notes
- summarizing experience
- extracting patterns
